Cricket Series Coverage Dominated by Match Commentaries

Multiple Indian media outlets provided live commentary and results for international cricket matches. Hindustan, a Hindi-language publication, featured live commentary for the Africa Continental Cup match between Kenya and Rwanda (Match-14) and the first T20 International of a three-match series between England and Sri Lanka. India Today, an English-language publication, also reported on the England vs. Sri Lanka T20 series, providing live scores and results for the 2026 cricket season.
